physDesc.additional: Script: 'bru tsha. Number on the last folio: 99. However, the total number of folios is 100: between the folios numbered 52 and 57, there are 4 folios with two sets of numbers, the second by a different hand - 56/53, 57/54, 58/55, 59/56 - and a folio with number "56 rjes ma." Lines per folio: 7. Rare annotations. Some parts appear faded an others blurred on the reproduction; they could have been in color on the original manuscript.

phyi
tsa
35
dbu ma rtsa ba'i rnaM bshad srog 'khor ||

lg.l: de ltar bdag gis rten 'brel stong ma dbu' ma'i lam ||
rtsa ba'i tshig don rnam par phye bas 'jig rten 'dis ||
chos la mig thob thabs kyi rkang pas rab bskyod te ||
'tsho ba kun bral thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog ||
bdag kyang tshe 'dir skyes bu dam pas mi dpyas shing ||
rang nyid dmus 'byung las kyi mtha' las log gyur te ||
nad med tshe yis tshangs par spyod pa mthar phyung nas ||
'gyod pa med cing dga' bas nying 'thsams sbyor bar shog ||

'di nas 'phos te gzhan gyis bar du
ma chod par ||
dal 'byor rten gyis gzhon gyur rab du byung gyur nas ||
dri med tshul ldan skyes bu dam pas 'dzin pa dang ||
ston pa'i bstan pa ji lta de ltar rtogs pa dang ||
ji lta de ltar sgrub la bar chad med pa yis ||
tshogs gnyis rdzogs te chos kyi rgyal por gyur nas kyang ||
'gro ba srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen por bying pa rnams ||
sna tshogs thabs kyis lus pa med par sgrol bar shog ||
don med ngal ba'i spyod pa mi 'dod pas ||
phyogs gzhan brtag pa'i 'bad pa 'dir ma byas ||
phan pas 'dod pa'i don tsam brjod pa 'di ||
kha brgyud gtam gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par ||
tsham tshom sangs te zla grags gzhung bzhin bshad ||
'khrul yang 'khrul pa'i nyes pa bdag la med ||
ji ltar sangs rgyas gsung la mi slu bas ||
yid ches tshad ma klu sgrub yin pa ltar ||
klu sgrub gzhung la yid ches mi slu ba'i ||
tshad ma'ang zla ba grags pa yin pa'i phyir ||
du bas me ltar de rjes bshad pa 'di ||
klu sgrub gzhung la 'khrul ces bdag mi sems ||
gang 'dir kha cig yang dag skye ba mi 'dod kyang ||
ming du gzhan skye tshad mas grub par 'dod pa la ||
rang med gzhan ni tha snyad du yang mi srid pas ||
gzhan ltar rang yang tha snyad don la grub par 'gyur ||
tha snyad don la bdag dang gzhan nyid yod na yang ||
rten 'byung min pas rang bzhin yod pa nyid du 'gyur ||
nam mkha' bzhin du rang bzhin 'gyur ba mi srid pas ||
mya ngan nyams thag sgom pa'i thang las thar mi 'gyur ||
klu sgrub rgya mtsho zla ba'i 'od kyis bsal ba'i chu ||
stong nyid bdud rtsi rtog ge'i rnyog mas ma scags pa ||
som nyi med par dad pas 'thung ba'i skal ldan dag ||
mya ngan nyams thag skyom pa'i thang las myur du thar ||
gang zhig bcad pas spros pa'i dra ba kun ||
gcod pa'i 'khor la rten nas 'byung pa'i don ||
spro bas bla ma'i lung bzhin bshad pa 'di ||
sngon chad gzhan la gtam du grags pa med ||
de phyir lca chan tshogs kyis ske phran ltar ||
bla ma'i man ngag snyan khung brgyud pa 'di ||
kha brgyud rtog ge kun gyis mi 'dod kyang ||

rnal 'byor skal
ldan rna brgyud can gyis blang ||
cung zad tshig gis don gyi gnad rnams nges gyur pa ||
'grel pa don chen rtsa ba'i srog gi 'khor lo 'di ||
thos pa 'dzin pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ge yis ||
dga' bas goms phyir bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod pa yin ||||

body.ab: dbu ma rtsa ba'i rnam par bshad pa srog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba | thos pa'i don yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba | rdzogs s+hO || dge'o ||||
